text: Hidden Tomb

One of our soldiers falls through a crack in the earth and lands in a great buried tomb. More are sent down with torches, and they come back laden with grave goods. Our lord takes the pick of them, and learns much from the carvings on the walls.
Abandoned Camp

Our vanguard finds an abandoned camp hidden between the hills, its tents still pitched and its stores still full. We check it for traps and find none, so the army rests and resupplies before moving on.
Buried Relics
A strange noise draws our scouts to a ruined village, where a passage opens beneath the old meeting hall. Inside lies a forgotten cache, and among the dust and bones is one prize worth the taking.
Hidden Temple
Deep in the ruins of an old city stands a temple untouched by time. Our lord keeps vigil there for a night and a day, and leaves with a quiet sense of protection that settles over the whole army.
Caravan Remnants
Smoke rises not far from our camp. Our scouts find a caravan attacked but not fully sacked, its guards dead and its raiders long gone, and what they left behind is ours now.
Legendary Bard Rescued

A desperate rider begs us to save their village from a slaver raid. We arrive in time, and among the freed captives is a famous bard, who promises to sing of our deeds in every hall and market across the land.
Whispers of Our God

Our lord's sleep is broken by a dream more vivid than any waking hour. A voice speaks of strength and of trials to come, and by morning the whole army fights as if nothing in the world could break it.
Challenge Won
The Explorers

A band of explorers asks to travel under the protection of our weapons until the road grows safer. In return they share their maps and their hard-won knowledge of the land, and our march grows swifter and surer.
The rival army yields the field, bruised and humbled. Their general salutes our strength before withdrawing, and word of the victory spreads through the ranks.
Challenge Declined
The rival general laughs and leads their army away, calling us cowards. Let us hope the insult is the worst that comes of it.
Smothered In The Crib

The nascent rebellion was quickly defeated before it could attract dangerous characters. Our general lets those who no longer have the will to fight disperse. They were never our true target, and now they better understand the difference between a mere belligerent mob and a real army.
A Band Of Weaklings Ignored

Our general laughs in their faces. We leave the camp of weaklings without laying a finger on them. They scatter quickly and desperately as we move away, the mere threat of our presence enough to cure their reckless stupidity.
Defeated Bandits

Dust settles on the battlefield. The members of the bandit regiment lie dead or captured on the field. None of them will ever see the light of day or trouble our empire again. By torturing their leader, we discovered their lair and took everything they stole to aid the empire's war effort.
An Uneventful Night

Come morning there are no more strange noises in the surroundings, just the expected sounds of the road. The advance party reports that behind the hill are the remains of a recently vacated camp. The bandits may have chosen not to attack at night due to the heavy guard posted by the general and the clear defensive position of the army. Maybe dodging them was for our own good?
Cropped Ears

The incursion has been repelled and the invaders lie dead on the battlefield. The army is motivated and takes the lessons of the battle to heart. Studying the weapons of the high elves, they learn how to better defend against arrows and hide from enemy eyes. Maybe with the help of our god it will work for a while?
A Suit of Scales

The incursion has been repelled and the invaders lie dead on the battlefield. The army is motivated and takes the lessons of the battle to heart. By studying the weapons and hides of the lizardmen, we learn how to improve our defenses and last longer in battle. Maybe with the help of our god it will work for a while?
Drowned Twice

The incursion has been repelled and the invaders lie dead on the battlefield. The army is motivated and takes the lessons of the battle to heart. By studying the magic of the enemy, we learn a few things that could help us survive. Maybe with the help of our god it will work for a while?
Territorial Plunder

The raiders plunder some of the riches of the land you are passing through. Although the inhabitants eventually drive them off, a wave of devastation is left across the territory. The people of your land and of this one give you the nickname "The Dishonored".
The Bull By The Horns

We have surprised the beastmen, beating them on their own ground. The forest, dyed red, seems to breathe a sigh of tranquility. The soldiers are motivated after the skirmish. The world has been purged of the vermin that torment it.
A Rat In The Trap

Despite being masters of subterfuge, the skaven could not stop the army's quick reaction and were devastated on the spot. For all their dead, it is clear that many of them escaped. Still, beating the skaven at their own game is clearly a sign of luck. We are blessed.
Massacre Averted
The danger past, it turns out you avoided a likely deadly ambush. The enemies, seeing that the army was rapidly retreating, could not surround it and ended up abandoning their attack.
A Green Memory

The greenskins and their legendary leader lie on the ground, defeated and strangely content. Apparently it was a memorable battle for them. They give us a powerful artifact and tell us that they will see us again for the next battle!
A Fitting End

Dead dark elves cover the plain as far as the eye can see. There is no trace of the slaver leaders and no sign that they can regroup any time soon. In the end, the people of our empire are safe. The slavers won't be showing up around here for a while. Our soldiers find artifacts in the main leader's tent, which will be better used by our forces.
Broken Bloodsucker Teeth

The necromancer and his few remaining followers fled as if they themselves had seen a ghost. The pile of bones left behind is so high that our wizards think it will take weeks to crumble away. An incredibly luxurious carriage, filled with relics, is the only thing left intact on the battlefield. It will be put to good use by our forces.
An Airy Tomb

Come morning, the reanimated bones of those who came to stop us move no more. The rest of their army, the one chasing the marauders, was lost from sight during the battle. Among the belongings of the fallen we find riches, but something tells us that taking them may be a bad idea, lest we suffer the same fate as the marauders. Still, army headquarters decides it is too good an opportunity to pass up, so we take the relics we find before continuing our march.
An Oath Fulfilled

You have helped the Slayers regain their honor. Somehow the legendary duo survived. Felix carries an unconscious Gotrek to safety while we finish off the last Slayer, for Gotrek's time has not yet come. Will Felix write about this new adventure of the dwarf? And what will he say about us?
Wise Retreat
We left behind the powerful and dangerous army that stood before us. We don't know what would have happened had we faced them, but at least we can be sure that we will live to fight another day.
A Gift from Khorne

Skarbrand begins to fade back into the Chaos he was born from. "WORTHY!" he seems to laugh as he fades away. "KHORNE SENDS HIS BLESSINGS TO YOU." He gives you a Khorne Cache. "FOR THE BATTLES TO COME."
From Beyond The Warp

The weapon before you seems otherworldly. The blade is always moving, too fast for the eye to follow, and makes a strange sound. Bringing the moving blade close to anything seems to destroy it with great ease. It seems to feed on what you kill. Better not let anyone but your forces take possession of it. You carry it with you to prevent someone else from having it.
Khorne Understands You Want a Challenge
The Master of War looks upon your victory with appreciation. Khorne rewards the best warriors. Your army is reinvigorated and fortified. War calls you!
A Gift from Khorne

Valkia smiles as her last warrior falls. To the Khornate it does not matter where the blood flows, as long as it flows. She points to a stash half-hidden by the terrain near a forest. "Sooner or later you will serve. And I will delight in fighting by your side when you do." You watch her fly through the sky and disappear. Beautiful and terrible, she leaves you wondering what blessing awaits you.
The Damned Spear

The spear before you is clearly cursed. You feel a vibrating and terrifying power. When you touch the spear, you feel it could unleash devastating power at your will. Better not let anyone but your forces take possession of it. You carry it with you to prevent someone else from having it.
Khorne Understands You Want a Challenge
The Master of War looks upon your victory with appreciation. Khorne rewards the best warriors. Your army is reinvigorated and fortified. War calls you!
A Gift from Khorne

The daemons are defeated and vanish. They cannot believe their defeat as they desperately try to cling to reality. "Be'lakor will destroy me... NOOOOO!" The leader of the daemons drops a stash hidden on his back. The other daemons try to reach him, but as they get closer they burn and are quickly dispelled back into Chaos. The presence of the God of War urges you to approach the cursed treasure...
The Ever Regenerating Blade

The blade of this weapon has strange teeth all the way around it. You feel as if the weapon is alive and has accumulated the life of the things it managed to kill. Better not let anyone but your forces take possession of it. You carry it with you to prevent someone else from having it.
Khorne Understands You Want a Challenge
The Master of War looks upon your victory with appreciation. Khorne rewards the best warriors. Your army is reinvigorated and fortified. War calls you!
A Gift from Khorne

Azazel smiles. With the defeat of the armies following him, he feels the sword lose its power over him. "Have it if you want it. It's useful, but I don't like something about it. Well, it was fun while it lasted. I know who I can turn to when I need to get out of trouble." He smiles at you, and you feel strangely happy to see his smile. Seeing him fly away makes you feel somehow sad. You look at the sword... maybe you could put it to some use.
The Corrupted Blade

The sword is clearly cursed. You feel the rage marked on the blade, but at the same time you feel wildness in it. Strangely, this blade seems to be marked by two opposing gods of Chaos, which gives it an odd balance. Better not let anyone but your forces take possession of it. You carry it with you to prevent someone else from having it.
Azazel's Prank

There is nothing special about this sword. It appears to be a simple sword, useful but nothing more. You hear Azazel laugh in the distance. It seems that this time the daemon did it just for fun, but your troops still welcome the experience and the loot from defeating his pursuers.
A Gift from Khorne Rejected

You feel Khorne's gaze intensify. You feel the violence of your heart rise and a sense of shame. You and your army shamefully avoided the challenge and now a sense of murderous desire haunts you. Your eyes are clouded with red. You should avoid battles for a while...
Khorne Understands You Want a Challenge
The Master of War looks upon your victory with appreciation. Khorne rewards the best warriors. Your army is reinvigorated and fortified. War calls you!
A Gift from Slaanesh

Sigvald flees in terror, cursing you. "Ugly creature, one day I will kill you and drink from your horrible skull!" Searching his camp, you find a stash that clearly seems to beckon you. Apparently Sigvald tried to open it, and when he couldn't, he left marks all over it in a fit of jealousy. It opens at the mere touch of your hands...
Slaanesh Wants Your Favour

A sword of unparalleled beauty lies before you. It shows none of the corruption you expected from the giver. It simply seems to have been made out of an obsession with the art of blacksmithing, in search of perfection. You test it by destroying everything in Sigvald's tent. It is not only beautiful but extremely useful. You take it with you.
Slaanesh Favours You
The Dark Prince finds you amusing. He blesses you for your strength and skill in fulfilling his desire. You feel strangely empowered. It seems he wishes you to amuse him further.
A Gift from Slaanesh

N'Kari trembles, not with anger but with pleasure. "I always love a good challenge!" He moves his tongue ecstatically, licking his lips. "Enter the next room, your prize is waiting for you." He touches your face and you feel compelled to obey. As you enter the room, the castle begins to shake and slowly disappears, leaving only the room you are in. In that room you find...
A Useful Follower

A strange man is writing in a beautiful little notebook. He has elven features, yet he also appears human, and you cannot place his race. He stops and greets you in an ostentatious manner. He shows extreme devotion to you, praising you whenever you wish and telling your troops of your greatness and glory. They seem motivated by his speeches, so you decide to take him with you on your travels.
Slaanesh Favours You
The Dark Prince finds you amusing. He blesses you for your strength and skill in fulfilling his desire. You feel strangely empowered. It seems he wishes you to amuse him further.
A Gift from Slaanesh

Morathi escapes, sacrificing part of her army to survive. With her betrayal foiled, we shouldn't see the dark elf again for some time. You feel a delighted laugh echo in your head. Without knowing how, you follow a path in the dark, protected by your best men. You find a broken carriage on the road and search it without thinking.
Slaanesh's Lover Joins You

Sitting in the carriage is a shackled woman of unparalleled beauty. You can't understand why, but looking at her you feel as if you are looking at not one but many women. She looks at you, and her face settles into that of a woman you find irresistible. You feel a shudder and a strange urge to protect her. You take her with you, not knowing exactly why but doing it anyway.
Slaanesh Favours You
The Dark Prince finds you amusing. He blesses you for your strength and skill in fulfilling his desire. You feel strangely empowered. It seems he wishes you to amuse him further.
A Gift from Slaanesh Rejected

A sensation of drowsiness and overwhelming debauchery takes hold of you. You feel the Dark Prince's disappointment and anger. You and your army don't seem ready to fight but feel compelled to do so. You must be careful which battles you fight...
Cleaning Up An Old Tower

We find the tower of a reclusive mage. On the floor lie small pieces of gold, and on the walls small scribbles of arcane knowledge tell stories of times long past. We absorb everything we can from them.
A Dream Too Vivid

You wake up with a chill and cold sweat all over your body. The dream was extremely vivid and you feel the adrenaline still running through your body as if you had been about to go into combat. But it was just a dream, nothing more. You feel reinvigorated by a strange force and you understand that the dream vision will eventually pass. You must prepare for the battle to come!
A Tribute From The Smithy

My warmest regards, my lord. Thank you for protecting our smithy from our enemies and the dangers that surround us. The master blacksmith sends you the promised tribute for your investment and protection. Use it for your war effort!
Raiders Repelled
The incursion has been repelled and the invaders lie dead on the field. What they looted is returned to the land, and the army takes the lessons of the battle to heart.
Ambush Turned
We turned their ambush against them and broke them on their own ground. The soldiers are in high spirits after the fight.
A Battle to Remember
The enemy army lies broken across the field. Among the spoils we find weapons and relics worth carrying into the wars to come.
Cast the Lots
The lots tumble from the cup and fall in our favour. The stranger who offered the game scowls, but pays up all the same, and a rare treasure changes hands.
Cast the Lots
The lots fall against us, as they so often do for strangers. The stranger sweeps up our stake with a crooked grin and is gone before anyone thinks to argue.
Drink from the Spring
The water runs cold and clear from the rock. Wounds close and tired limbs grow strong again as the whole army drinks its fill.
Drink from the Spring
The water tastes of rot and old iron. Within hours sickness spreads through the camp, and the army will march weaker for some time.
Open the Sealed Door
The seal breaks and the door grinds open on a chamber untouched for centuries. At its heart lies a treasure of legend, and now it is ours.
Open the Sealed Door
The seal breaks, and so does the trap behind it. Our lord is caught in the blast and carried from the chamber, badly wounded.
Double or Nothing
The bet is called and the throw comes up in our favour. Our stake returns to the treasury doubled, and the house is not pleased about it.
Double or Nothing
The bet is called and the throw turns against us. Our stake is gone, and the house thanks us warmly for our custom.
Wake the Guardian
The great beast stirs, snorts and settles back into its slumber. We creep past it and make off with a rare treasure from its hoard.
Wake the Guardian
The ground shakes as the guardian of this place rises from its slumber. It sees intruders in its lair and charges, and our army must stand and fight!
Touch the Relic
Warmth spreads from the relic into the hands that hold it. A blessing settles over the army, and the soldiers march a little taller for it.
Touch the Relic
The relic is cold as a grave, and a creeping dread spreads through the ranks. A curse settles over the army, though it should not last long.
Gamble with the Hermit
The hermit squints at the dice, then laughs and shuffles off into the hut. They return with a unique treasure and press it into our hands.
Gamble with the Hermit
The hermit wins throw after throw, cackling all the while. When the game is done our gold is in the hermit's pouch, and the hermit is gone.
Endow the Province

Our gold builds roads, walls and storehouses across [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. The region grows stronger and richer, and its people will remember who paid for it.
Garrison Drill

Fresh supplies reach the garrison of [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], and its officers drill the defenders from dawn to dusk. Its walls are manned by harder soldiers now.
Raise the Settlement

Builders swarm over [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], raising new halls and stronger walls. In a matter of days its heart stands a level higher than before.
Quell the Unrest

Our soldiers walk the streets of [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], and the loudest troublemakers fall quiet. Order returns, for now.
Bountiful Harvest

The fields around [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]] groan under a bountiful harvest. The stores fill, the markets swell, and the people prosper.
Stir Their Rebels

Our agents spread grievances and weapons among the malcontents of [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. Unrest spreads through the enemy's lands.
Poison Their Wells

Under cover of night, our agents foul the wells of [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. Sickness spreads through its people, and any army camped there will suffer for it.
Sap Their Garrison

Our saboteurs slip into [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], spoiling stores, cutting ropes and spreading sickness through the barracks. Its garrison is weakened and shaken.
Spread the Plague

We drive the sick and the dying toward the enemy's lands around [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. The plague spreads, though our own army does not escape it entirely.
Send Gifts

Our gifts are well received at [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. Their rulers speak of us more warmly now, and remember who remembered them.
Spy on Their Capital

Our spies slip into [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]] and map every wall and gate, and we will see its streets for some time yet. They count its garrison: [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_detail").StringValue}}[[/col]].
Curse a Distant King

A curse falls on the treasury of the court at [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. Their wealth dwindles, and they will never know why.
Share the Find

We share what we found with our neighbours, starting at [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. Their scholars are grateful, and think better of us for it.
Point Them at Each Other

Rumours spread from [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], carefully planted by our agents. Two rivals now eye each other with suspicion.
Sell Their Secrets

The secrets fetch a fine price at [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]]. But word travels, and our enemies grow closer to one another.
Ransom the Captain

Their captain is ransomed back to [[col:yellow]]{{CcoCampaignEventIncident:ScriptObjectContext("land_enc_spot_result_place").StringValue}}[[/col]], and the price is paid in full. Their kin will not forget the humiliation.
Chase the Routers
Our fastest troops run the fleeing enemy down before they reach safety. Among the spoils they drop is a rare item, and it is ours.
Chase the Routers
The fleeing enemy were bait. They turn on our pursuers in a narrow pass, and our lord takes a wound that will lay them low for a time.
Headhunt
The enemy lord fell in time, just as we vowed. Their finest possession, a rare item, now belongs to us.
Headhunt
The enemy lord lived too long, and our vow goes unfulfilled.
Blood Tally
The enemy's soldiers fell in their hundreds, and the tally is met. The gold we were promised is ours.
Blood Tally
Too few of the enemy fell, and the tally comes up short.
Hold the Line
Our line bent but never broke, and few of our units were lost. The gold we were promised is ours.
Hold the Line
Our line held in the end, but too many of our units were lost along the way.
Swift Victory
The battle was over almost before it began. Word of the swift victory spreads, and an extra item comes our way.
Swift Victory
The battle dragged on too long for the victory to be called swift.
Guard the Standard
The marked unit stood firm through the worst of the fighting. They return as hardened veterans, 3 ranks the wiser.
Guard the Standard
The marked unit was lost in the fighting, and their sacrifice earns no reward.
Break Them
Unit after unit of theirs broke and fled before us. The gold we were promised is ours.
Break Them
Too few of their units broke, and they fought on to the bitter end.
Trophy Hunt
Their finest unit fell to our blades. Its survivors are pressed into our service, and a copy of it joins our army.
Trophy Hunt
Their finest unit survived the battle, and the trophy slips through our fingers.
Silence the Guns
Their guns fell silent before they could do much harm. Among the wreckage we find a rare item, and it is ours.
Silence the Guns
Their guns kept firing for too long, and the mission is failed.
Bloodbath Wager
The field ran red, and the wager is won. The gold comes back to us many times over.
Bloodbath Wager
Too few of the enemy fell, and the gold we wagered is lost.
Duellist's Challenge
Our lord met theirs blade to blade and struck them down. A unique item is taken from the fallen lord, and it is ours.
Duellist's Challenge
Our lord did not slay theirs, and the challenge goes unanswered.
Spare the Captain
Their lord was taken alive, just as we planned. The ransom has been paid, and the gold is ours.
Spare the Captain
Their lord fell in the fighting, so there is no one left to ransom.
Untouchable
Our lord came through the fighting barely scratched, and the army will not stop talking about it. The experience will not be forgotten.
Untouchable
Our lord took too many wounds for the vow to hold.
Flawless Victory
Not a single unit of ours was lost. Songs of the flawless victory spread far, and a unique item is ours.
Flawless Victory
We lost a unit, and the victory was not flawless.
Missions
The battle was fought without our watchful eyes on it, so none of our missions could be judged. Any gold we wagered is returned to our treasury.
The Price Is Paid
The price of what we took comes due at once. Our lord is struck down by a wound that will take 2 turns to heal.
The Price Is Paid
The price of what we took comes due at once. Our lord is struck down by a wound that will take 3 turns to heal.
The Price Is Paid
The price of what we took comes due at once. Our lord is struck down by a wound that will take 5 turns to heal.
